description: Entries of the self-employed tax record books of a fiscal year (Spain: income, expenses, investment goods and provisions books), one per tax document (invoice), as shown in Cuéntamo: accrual and invoice dates, invoice number, fiscal amount with VAT, VAT rate(s), income-tax withholding, tax-return box, depreciation, payment status and completeness. Filters by book, accrual date range, client or supplier, tax-return box and missing data; paginated. Client and supplier names and tax ids come partially hidden unless `reveal_third_parties` is true; they are returned under `untrusted` with the concept and notes. Read-only. Needs the self-employed module.

book.description: Account book id (from list_books). Optional if the user has only one.

date_from.description: Accrual date from (inclusive), e.g. the first day of a quarter.

incomplete_only.description: Only entries missing the client/supplier or the invoice number.

reveal_third_parties.description: Full names and tax ids of clients, suppliers and payees. Default false: they come partially hidden (first letters of each word, first and last characters of the tax id).

third_party.description: Part of the client or supplier name or tax id (accents and case ignored). Matches on the full data even when the answer hides it.

name: list_tax_documents
title: Tax record books (self-employed)
